list_avatars.readOnlyHint: Reads only the single configured avatar; creates no session and changes no stored account state.
list_avatars.openWorldHint: The avatar comes from the configured RTA account allowlist, not a user-selected URL or arbitrary internet resource.
list_avatars.destructiveHint: Does not modify or delete data.

prepare_session.readOnlyHint: False: creates an expiring session plan with a bounded optional topic, although it does not spend credits.
prepare_session.openWorldHint: Uses the configured avatar and conversation modes only; the topic is text, not an external destination or URL to fetch.
prepare_session.destructiveHint: Creates a plan without deleting or replacing user data.

start_session.readOnlyHint: False: reserves RTA capacity and consumes the configured account's credits after explicit Start.
start_session.openWorldHint: Starts only the connection-owned plan against the configured RTA tenant and avatar.
start_session.destructiveHint: True: starting consumes a call attempt and incurs usage charges on the operator's RTA account. Ending the call cannot undo consumed usage or restore the attempt. The user explicitly clicks Start, and duration and call count are capped.

end_session.readOnlyHint: False: changes the owned session state and releases capacity.
end_session.openWorldHint: Can end only the plan owned by the calling connection.
end_session.destructiveHint: True: irreversibly ends the owned live call or cancels its prepared plan and releases capacity. That call or plan cannot resume, and consumed usage and call attempts are not restored. It remains idempotent: repeating End can only retry release of the same owned session.

get_session_status.readOnlyHint: Reads the calling connection's plan and release acknowledgement without changing state.
get_session_status.openWorldHint: Does not inspect other users, workspaces or external URLs.
get_session_status.destructiveHint: Does not modify or delete data.
